title: Ký ức mờ
about: Round x4 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi"): a faded memory, the most tune of this round: the music box plays a whole slow melody, the glass answering it far off, the pad and choir under them. B minor at 58 bpm, warming to D and G in the middle. An original piece.
